about: A folder item's body is rendered only where a template reads it as item.content in its loop; passed to a function (or read by a computed node's expression) it is carried as written, so there it is plain text, no tag and no raw block (chapter 5 § 5.6.2; chapter 4 § 4.7.7; this implementation's sentence). The loop standards' call section passes item to the function draft_section as param.standard. Invalid: hpi's body writes item.value.title. Valid: it writes only text.
